status: One receive-only managed sign-out retires the entire active session while preserving local owner identity and effective sharing. The same GUI/credential explicitly starts a fresh process and captures fresh local DAX IQ, then normal Stop and exact cleanup pass. Sign-out is not managed token revocation; lost-owner recovery/rotation remains unfinished.
negative_evidence_retained: The initial post-retirement audit expected the three control processes retained by normal Stop. It failed because authority retirement removes the session manager/frontend too. That failure is preserved; a separate stricter audit pins the sole primary PID26446 and requires all12 original session processes absent. No product guard was loosened.
scope_limits: This is managed same-owner authority-lifetime retirement, not successful local-owner-token revocation, credential loss or recovery/rotation. No new public credential operation was invented or claimed.
Only a verified local-only installation without a saved tailnet identity was used. Joined-account logout, membership loss, expiry or control-plane behavior is not qualified.
HTTP roundtrip is not a bound on full process retirement. Resource audits were performed afterward; initial PD status503/unavailable was retained, not relabeled stopped.

Stream ID and source generation may repeat across fresh DSP processes. Freshness is proved using different observed DSP PIDs, complete intervening retirement and increasing receive timestamps, not those identifiers alone.

The ordinary GUI started/stopped the sessions; one fixed-path CLI used the production Qt keychain reader for the normal authenticated sign-out endpoint. The Remote Access dialog enrollment/logout UI is not qualified by this CLI operation.

Existing diagnostic bootstrap was used for fixed read/cleanup audits with privileges dropped before identity reads. No installation, persistent privilege change, software reboot, new app instance, AetherTX or processing-settings restoration occurred.

All remaining P1-P10 installation, current-graph fault, credential recovery/rotation, cold/alignment, repeated/raw/extended RF, final stock comparison, actual6300 and independent production review gates remain open.
